symbols.name: scalar ring
symbols.meaning: The ring of scalars carried by the wires.
symbols.quote: Let $R$ be the ring of scalars carried by the wires, and let $\Omega$ be a finite set of addresses indexing every array.

symbols.name: pointwise network
symbols.meaning: The network acting on all the wire arrays together, each gate applied at every address separately.
symbols.quote: Write $\mathsf S_\Omega$ for the resulting network acting on all the wire arrays together.

symbols.name: frame
symbols.meaning: The invertible R-linear operator on R^Omega assigned to the source, gate or sink v.
symbols.quote: At each source, gate and sink $v$, assign an invertible $R$-linear operator $D_v$ on $R^\Omega$, called its frame.

symbols.name: gate input count
symbols.meaning: The number of input arrays of the gate G.
symbols.quote: At a gate $G$ with $t$ input arrays, every incoming array has the common frame $D_v$, and a gate output combines the logical inputs $\varphi_1,\dots,\varphi_t$ with coefficients $c_j\in R$.

symbols.name: role permutation
symbols.meaning: The map sending each input role w to its output role rho(w) in a signed role permutation.
symbols.quote: So if the scalar network is a signed role permutation sending input role $w$ to output role $\rho(w)$ with scalar sign $\varepsilon_w$, that route applies $\varepsilon_wD_{\mathrm{sink}(\rho(w))}D_{\mathrm{source}(w)}^{-1}$ to its input array.

symbols.name: role sign
symbols.meaning: The scalar sign carried by the route from input role w.
